relationships.subject: Nav1.8
relationships.evidence_quote: a sodium channel that is essential for repetitive firing of peripheral pain-signalling neurons and has no essential function in the CNS

key_findings: Nav1.8 inhibition partially reduces acute postoperative pain in humans, but translation to chronic pain remains unproven.
Perspective on whether more effective Nav1.8 blockers are feasible and whether CNS changes limit pain relief in chronic pain.
